visible_findings: A low green-brown timber barrier spans the target-facing edge of the dirt firing platform, between shooter and target scenery.
Capped uprights carry thick horizontal timbers; a central panel contains diagonals, with closely paired posts separating adjacent rail sections.

A curved timber lip borders the visible foreground dirt platform. Behind the rail, freestanding mountain and castle-shaped scenery occupies distinct depth layers before a larger painted mountain/conifer backdrop.
Straw target forms appear in front of scenery at differing depths; perspective and occlusion prevent a complete count.
limits: The low barrier is transverse to the shooting view. It does not establish the full range perimeter, side-rail extent, end openings, or present Minecraft axes.
The diagonal braces and capped members are visible original shapes. Stock spruce fences, selected positions and openings are block-scale adaptations.
No exact lengths, height calibration, complete target count, lighting level or movement behavior can be measured from this still.
